author: Özer (@ddoemonn), interior.dev
changes: Write through the shared copyTextToClipboard (fail-closed, the WKWebView-safe path) instead of the component's own fallback.
Draw on the shared Coss button and Tooltip instead of its own styled motion.button, so the look follows the workspace tokens.

Split the state into useCopy, the mark (CopyMark) and the cross-fading words (CopyWords) so a control that does more than copy (an app tab that copies its setup message when picked) shows the same state.
A newer press wins over an earlier answer; nothing is set after unmount; a pending write disables the button.
A refused write is said in an alert; framer-motion's useReducedMotion shows each state at once.
